title: Data Engineer
description:
Your role at Veezu:
 As a Data Engineer, you'll build and maintain the data platform that powers reporting, analytics and data science across Veezu. Reporting into the Director of Data Engineering, you'll work hands-on with Microsoft Fabric, SQL, Python/PySpark and Power BI, bringing data in from our booking systems, databases and third-party APIs and shaping it into trusted, well-modelled datasets that the business relies on every day.
 Who are Veezu?
 Veezu is the UK's fastest growing taxi and private hire technology business operating across hundreds of UK towns and cities. We are a tech-driven on-demand mobility service that supports our hyper-local communities, helping them thrive and so much more!
 What you’ll do:
 Design, build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines in Microsoft Fabric using Pipelines, Notebooks, Lakehouses, Warehouses and OneLake.
 Write PySpark notebooks to ingest and transform data from SQL Server databases, REST APIs, SaaS applications and file-based exports.
 Develop and optimise SQL transformations, stored procedures and Kimball-style star-schema data models.
 Build and support Power BI semantic models and the datasets behind dashboards used by teams across the business.
 Implement data quality, validation and reconciliation checks so numbers match across systems.
 Monitor production pipelines and troubleshoot data, performance and refresh issues.
 Use Git, automated testing and CI/CD to support reliable, repeatable deployments.
 Maintain clear documentation, data lineage and engineering standards.
 Work with analysts and business stakeholders to turn requirements into practical data solutions.
 Be committed to maintaining our ISO27001 certification and set high standards for Information Security compliance.
 What you’ll need:
 Essential
 2-4 years' experience in a data engineering role.
 Strong SQL skills, including complex transformations and performance tuning.

title: Staff Data Engineer, Tech Foundations
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
 Staff Data Engineer, Enterprise Core Datasets, Tech Foundations
 The Community You Will Join:
 At Airbnb, trustworthy data powers business decisions, product innovation, and operational efficiency. The Enterprise Core Datasets team builds the technical data foundations that help Airbnb understand how the business operates, where resources are invested, and how new technologies create value.
 Our scope spans high-impact datasets across the organization: measuring AI adoption, usage, and cost; understanding revenue, costs, and profitability through Unit Economics; integrating non-platform data from Jira and other enterprise applications; and powering critical company metrics such as Gross Booking Value and Revenue.
 You will join a team that values thoughtful architecture, engineering rigor, and operational ownership. We collaborate with engineering, product, analytics, finance, and business teams to turn complex requirements into dependable, reusable data assets. We welcome strong engineers who are curious about the business and eager to solve problems across diverse domains.
 The Difference You Will Make:
 As a Staff Data Engineer, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for datasets that shape decisions across Airbnb. Your work will help the organization measure AI adoption and spending, understand the economics of its products, and connect enterprise application data to meaningful business and operational insights.
